critique.evidence: No motion was demonstrated in standard mode at any viewport: activeAnimationCount=0 and changedElementCount=0 across all 12-frame samples, with only one transition-capable element detected. Reduced-motion behavior is clean—mediaMatches=true, zero active animations, and zero changed elements. Tablet and mobile timing is stable near 16.7ms with no long frames; desktop is weaker at 20.73ms overall/20.93ms on-screen average and a 33.4ms worst frame. This proves restraint and accessibility, but not polished animation quality.
critique.fix: Provide measured frames for an intentional interaction or entrance sequence across desktop, tablet, and mobile, showing coherent easing, duration, continuity, and final state. Include the equivalent reduced-motion capture, and optimize desktop rendering toward a consistent 16.7ms frame budget without 33ms spikes.
